text.tspan: Service — By being Wrought upon by the Lord
How can such as I approach Thee
By Thy Blood, O Lamb, that cleansed me,
Hands once empty now receive Thee;
We to tent of meeting go;
Hands are filled with offerings daily,
Meeting not just our own need,
But, O Father, Thy deep longing:
No more lepers! Priests for aye!
